title: Fail coverage closed on unknown stacks and stale reports
goal: Ensure every passing coverage result comes from a recognized stack and a report generated by the current command run.
in_scope: Validate every coverage.stacks allowlist entry against detected stack identifiers
Exit 2 when configured stacks resolve to no runnable stack instead of returning skipped/pass
Remove or freshness-check each declared summary before executing its custom or target command
Fail a target whose command exits zero without producing a new readable summary
out_of_scope: Trusting report timestamps without guarding coarse filesystem timestamp resolution
acceptance: Configured coverage.stacks entries that do not match detected stack identifiers exit 2 instead of producing a skipped pass, and each executed custom or explicit target must create or update its declared summary during the current run; a successful command that leaves only a pre-existing report fails the coverage run.
invariants: Malformed configuration never degrades into a successful skip
Reports from --reuse remain explicitly separated from normal current-run execution
A failed or reportless target makes the aggregate result fail
